headline: Congress honors 9/11 anniversary as both chambers observe moment of silence with most business on hold.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met briefly in pro forma session on September 10, holding only a 30-second meeting before adjourning for the long weekend. No substantive business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House convened for just three minutes on September 10 to pass a resolution honoring the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks. The chamber then adjourned as a mark of respect to the victims.

onTheFloor.title: Expressing the sense of the House regarding the terrorist attacks on September 11, 2001
